versions.subject: new rules: Sigma rules based on Elastic rules (#3632)
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    Image|endswith: '/sh'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '=$(curl '
        - 'eval'
selection_2:
    Image|endswith: '/curl'
    CommandLine|contains: '_intermediate_agent_'
condition: 1 of selection_*
